text:
evan: Heads-up: seeing sustained queue growth on shared-pool-eu-west during last 6h, tail lat spikes and a single tenant accounts for ~60% of queued tokens. digging in.
meera: yea saw that in graphs, tenant T-42 had 4x normal inflight, other tenants starved. any rate-limits firing?
zack: rate-limits triggered but were too coarse. requests were short-lived but very high rate -> KV-cache churn.
lina: idea: implement a 'quiet eviction' soft-backoff that reduces per-tenant concurrency progressively instead of hard eviction. emit 429s with Retry-After and meter on a penalty score.
evan: sketch of policy: moving average queue > threshold => increase penalty; penalty governs max-inflight = base * (1 - min(0.9, penalty)); penalty decays over time.
meera: can we make it cooperative with client Retry-After, and a server-side grace to let streaming finish? avoid killing in-flight generations.
zack: agree. prefer incremental throttling: throttle new request acceptance, not active streams. also mark tenant as noisy in metrics.
ops-bot: alert muted for noisy-tenant during canary. (auto)
lina: config example:
```
policy: quiet_eviction_v1
params:
  queue_threshold: 80  # percent
  ma_window_sec: 60
  penalty_increment: 0.15
  penalty_decay_sec: 300
  min_inflight_fraction: 0.1
  retry_after_seconds: 3
```
meera: metrics to add: tenant_queue_p95, tenant_penalty_score, tenant_rejected_rate, tenant_retry_after_count.
evan: rollout plan: canary eu-west on shared-pool-2 only, 48h, add dashboard and sampling of rejected requests. if good, expand 2 more pools.
zack: small code sketch for admission check:
```
if tenant_queue_pct > cfg.queue_threshold:
  tenant.penalty += cfg.penalty_increment
  tenant.max_inflight = base * max(cfg.min_inflight_fraction, 1 - tenant.penalty)
  reject_with_429(retry_after=cfg.retry_after_seconds)
else:
  tenant.penalty = max(0, tenant.penalty - decay)
```
lina: worry: billing/observability implications; must tag rejections and ensure customers see friendly messages + docs.
meera: also need to update SLA playbook with steps to contact tenant when penalty > 0.5 for > 1h.
evan: action items: meera write dashboard + alert (ETA tomorrow), zack implement admission check + unit tests (ETA Fri), lina docs + customer messaging (ETA Mon), i'll run canary and watch.
lina: assign follow-up with support for tenant outreach if needed.
meera: note: tie into routing so can fallback heavy tenant to dedicated capacity if customer has reserved pool.
zack: question: how do we compute base per-tenant inflight? per tenant SLO or weighted share? propose weight = tenant.commit or default floor.
evan: yes use weight = max(1, tenant.reserved_units) to compute fair share.
meera: ok. I'll update design doc after code lands.
ops-bot: deployment scheduled to canary cluster at 2026-03-19T03:00:00Z by infra-ci.
evan: thanks all, will post post-mortem template if canary reveals issues.
